title: Federated learning method, electronic device and storage medium based on node selection strategy

pse.problem: Limited computing processing performance and network bandwidth of a parameter server in federation learning when a large number of nodes participate in each round of iterative training.
pse.solution_function: A federal learning method selects nodes with larger influence on reducing overall training loss of a global model to participate in local model training of each round, thereby accelerating the convergence speed of the federal learning model.
pse.solution_structure: The system includes client nodes, a parameter server, and possibly storage media. Client nodes provide local training samples, evaluation values, and update gradients. The parameter server issues model parameters to selected client nodes.
pse.solution_implementation: Client nodes determine if they are fully selected. If not, each node obtains an evaluation value corresponding to the node, weights the number of local training samples by taking a module of the evaluation value as a weight, calculates the selected probability according to the ratio of the weighted number of local training samples to the sum of the weighted numbers in the federal learning system, and selects a set of nodes based on their calculated probabilities. The parameter server issues model parameters to these selected nodes which use them for local training and obtain update gradients.
pse.effect: The method results in an increase in convergence speed of the federal learning model and a reduction in overall training time.
